title: Roho yoroheje iri mu bahanuzi
intro: Ijwi rihamagarira abantu gukiranuka ryumvikana mu mirongo ya Korowani Nziza. Uyu muntu w’umugisha yahawe ubuhanuzi n’ibyanditswe byera mu gihe cyari gikenewe cyane mu bana ba Isirayeli. Uyu muntu yavuganye n’abantu be, abashishikariza kwibuka Umwami wabo. Binyuze mu kwihangana no kwitanga, babaye urumuri rw’inkuru ye imurikira amapaji y’ibyanditswe byera. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu w’igitangaza ufite izina rye ry’icyubahiro muri Korowani no mu Ivanjiri?
clues: Nahawe icyubahiro cyo guhabwa ubuhanuzi n'igitabo cyo mu ijuru mu gihe cy'ubukene bw'abantu banjye.
Mama yarambyaye mu buryo butangaje, binyuze mu itegeko ry'Imana ryonyine.
Nabwiye abantu banjye nti 'Yemwe bana ba Isirayeli! Ndi intumwa y'Imana kuri mwe, yemeza ibyari byambanjirije.'
Naje mfite ibimenyetso bisobanutse biturutse ku Mwami wawe, nzanye inkuru nziza y'umuhanuzi witwaga Ahmad.
Mama yari umugore w’umukiranutsi wanyeguriye gukorera Allah kuva nkiri muto.
Allah yanyigishije Qurani kandi ampa imbabazi n'umurava kuri mama, kandi sinari umwibone cyangwa ngo mbe umugome.
arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
